ext_test_any.quote: Third party evaluator(s) tested Gemini 3 Pro for autonomous systems risks,
ext_test_any.note: Gemini 3 Pro FSF Report is a model-specific safety report (clarification 9). External Safety Testing sections on pp5, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16-17 report third-party red teaming and evaluations of Gemini 3 Pro in CBRN, cyber, manipulation, ML R&D sabotage and deception.

ext_test_named_org.note: Third-party evaluators are never named. The only named outside organisation, Panoplia Laboratories (wet-lab uplift trial, p8), tested earlier models including Gemini 2.5 Pro: 'While these results were on a previous version of Gemini' (clarification 7). Eval note and card pages name no testing organisation.

ext_test_government.note: No government body or AI safety institute is named as a tester in the FSF report, the eval note, or any viewed page or figure. HuBREC (p11) is an internal ethics committee.

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: For Gemini 3 Pro, external safety testing was performed on a similar earlier version to the final version of Gemini 3 Pro.
ext_test_timing_stated.note: Outside testing ran on a pre-final checkpoint and informed the CCL determination; p22 adds the deployment decision 'was based on internal and external testing results', so the testing is stated to precede release.

safeguards_access.note: Safety mitigations section (pp21-22) describes guardrails, filters, classifiers and red teaming but no access restriction, tiering or trusted-access programme. No figure or card page adds one.

safeguards_weights.quote: robust cybersecurity measures and mitigations to protect Gemini 3 Pro and its associated model parameters from unauthorized access, releases and theft
safeguards_weights.note: Security mitigations section of the model-specific FSF report states protection of this model's parameters against theft.
